readings.Aries: You've been holding a position past the point where holding it costs more than releasing it. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Taurus: Your sense of value — what things are worth, what people cost — is usually accurate. Check it again today. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Gemini: Your cross-talk with the world is high. Reduce cognitive load; something important is trying to get through. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Cancer: You've given your energy to a situation that cannot return it. Time to redirect. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Leo: You require appreciation the way cells require oxygen. Name this without shame. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Virgo: Something you're maintaining out of habit is no longer serving the purpose it was built for. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Libra: You've been giving people the benefit of the doubt past the point where the doubt is informative. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Scorpio: You are more forgiving than your reputation suggests. One person knows this. Let a second. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Sagittarius: The teacher in this situation is not the one you expected. They're delivering the lesson anyway. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Capricorn: The authority you carry was earned. Use it with care today. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Aquarius: You've been consistent about one thing that no one has noticed. You can keep going without the notice. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: You have given people the version of yourself they could handle. Show someone the rest. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
